original_question:
Write a Verilog module named `counter`.

This module should implement a 4-bit synchronous up/down counter with an asynchronous reset and an enable signal.

The counter should operate on the positive edge of the input clock, `clk`.
It should reset asynchronously to zero on the positive edge of the `rst` input.
Counting should only occur when the `en` input is high.
When `en` is high, the counter should increment if the `up` input is high, and decrement if the `up` input is low.
When `en` is low, the counter should hold its current value.

The module should have the following interface:
Inputs: `clk`, `rst`, `en`, `up`
Output: `count` (a 4-bit register)
